comment: The Bead command (mitcad#2645; tools/ui-sheet-bead-test.sh and its Windows and macOS twins): sheet rules F1 (t = 1, r = 2, K = 0.4, back reference: the plate lies below XY, its top face on it), Sketch1 F2 with a 60 x 40 rectangle and the sheet Face F3 (F3.b0, 2400 mm3); Sketch2 F4 on XY, on the plate's top face, with the line c1 from (10, 20) to (50, 20), the bead's centre line.
